scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rimo/shared && concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rimo/api" "npm run dev -w @rimo/admin"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @rimo/shared && npm run dev -w @rimo/api
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build -w @rimo/shared && npm run dev -w @rimo/admin
scripts.dev:admin:5174: npm run build -w @rimo/shared && npm run dev:5174 -w @rimo/admin
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rimo/shared && npm run build -w @rimo/api && npm run build -w @rimo/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rimo/shared && npm run lint -w @rimo/api && npm run lint -w @rimo/admin
